definition: New work arriving in interval t. No public scheduler traces exist; the stochastic module draws scale-free Cox-process counts.
equation_transformation_model: Poisson counts from diurnal/weekly/AR log-intensity; not recovered arrivals
modeling_assumptions: base_rate=72; mixed interactive/batch Cox scenario; scale-free by construction
accuracy_diagnostic_available: structural queue conservation only; no arrival telemetry
missing_information_limitation: Hourly IT workload traces are not public.

definition: Work executed in t from a stable aggregate queue. Stochastic only; conditional reconstruction has no queue.
equation_transformation_model: aggregate service recursion from Gamma-compounded job sizes
modeling_assumptions: queue carried 2011-2024; conservation checked in stochastic_proxy_checks.csv
missing_information_limitation: Not recovered from public data.

definition: Usable compute capacity. Not identified from public sources.
missing_information_limitation: No hardware inventory, nameplate IT MW time series, or scheduler availability.

definition: Share of usable capacity that is active. Stochastic module uses a scale-free utilization_index from executed work; it is not measured u=x/K.
equation_transformation_model: utilization_index from executed work; mapped to IT-power shape then annually rescaled
modeling_assumptions: index is not a physical 0-1 utilization of known K
missing_information_limitation: No rack/server utilization telemetry.

definition: Unfinished work in the stochastic aggregate queue.
modeling_assumptions: nonnegative queue; carried across years
missing_information_limitation: Not a scheduler queue.

definition: Job delay and class delay limits. Not implemented.
missing_information_limitation: No job timestamps or SLA constraints in the pipeline.

definition: Electricity used by IT equipment. Conditional reconstruction uses one latent constant-within-year IT-power scale so gray-box facility energy closes to reported annual facility MWh. Stochastic uses a workload shape then the same annual closure.
primary_source: Meta annual facility electricity + NOAA weather + gray-box
equation_transformation_model: P_IT_scale = E_fac_reported / sum_t P_fac(weather, P_IT=1 MW); hourly P_IT = scale (conditional) or scale × shape (stochastic)
modeling_assumptions: constant IT power within a year in the conditional baseline; gray-box linear in IT power; not observed PDU telemetry
confidence_level: low for hourly path; medium that annual IT energy is in a physically consistent PUE range
missing_information_limitation: Hourly IT load is not public. Within-year variation is assumed (conditional) or scenario (stochastic).

definition: Hourly IT power summed to MWh. Derived from fitted/simulated P_IT.
implementation_status: implemented as derived from fitted P_IT
modeling_assumptions: piecewise-constant hourly power
missing_information_limitation: No measured IT energy series.

definition: KRDM Global Hourly dry-bulb, RH, pressure; wet-bulb computed in prepare_weather.py.
raw_fields: NCEI Global Hourly TMP, DEW, SLP, WND, AA1 as parsed by prepare_weather.py
processed_fields: t_db_C; t_dew_C; rh_pct; pressure_Pa; t_wb_C; precip_mm
modeling_assumptions: KRDM is an acceptable weather driver; not campus microclimate
independent_validation_source: optional closer Prineville AWOS not in pipeline
confidence_level: high as KRDM observations; medium as campus driver
missing_information_limitation: Off-campus station bias unquantified.

definition: Operational-scale IT heat. Gray-box uses Q_IT ≈ P_IT to size airflow: m_air = P_IT×1e6 / (c_p × ΔT_server).
implementation_status: implemented as physics identity inside gray-box
processed_fields: implicit in m_air; not a stored column
modeling_assumptions: near-total conversion of IT electricity to sensible heat; no thermal storage state
confidence_level: medium as an accounting assumption; unvalidated locally
missing_information_limitation: No loop heat measurements.

definition: Heat that must be removed. Code uses the IT-heat airflow requirement; building heat and dU/dt are not modeled.
equation_transformation_model: Q_cool ≈ Q_IT; no building or storage terms
modeling_assumptions: IT-dominated hall; hourly storage neglected
missing_information_limitation: No measured cooling load or building heat.

definition: Rack/inlet/GPU temperatures. Only supply-air temperature from the evaporative controller is computed.
equation_transformation_model: t_full = t_db - ε max(t_db-t_wb,0); t_supply = t_db if t_db≤25 else 25 if reachable else t_full
modeling_assumptions: no RC thermal model; return_air_C=35 is unused in the controller equations
missing_information_limitation: No rack/inlet telemetry. return_air_C prior is declared but not used in simulate().

definition: Gray-box discrete mode: outside_air_or_winter_mix / partial_evap / full_evap from weather vs 25 C target.
equation_transformation_model: if t_db≤target: outside_air_or_winter_mix; elif t_full≤target: partial_evap; else full_evap
modeling_assumptions: 2011 article: outside-air evaporative cooling, no chiller plant. Mode is weather-rule, not telemetry.
confidence_level: medium for technology class; low for hourly mode
missing_information_limitation: No BMS mode telemetry. Later buildings could differ; permits do not state a chiller/evaporative switch.

definition: Setpoints/fan speeds/flows. Only the 25 C supply target and evaporative effectiveness prior are used.
equation_transformation_model: fixed supply target and effectiveness; spray fraction = clip((t_db-t_supply)/max(t_db-t_wb,ε),0,1)
modeling_assumptions: no MPC, no learned policy
missing_information_limitation: Exact cooling setpoint/control telemetry is not public.

definition: Gray-box has no chiller COP. Cooling-related electricity is p_fan + p_evap_aux only.
implementation_status: implemented as fan + evaporative-aux fractions of IT power
equation_transformation_model: p_fan=0.025 P_IT; p_evap_aux=0.005 P_IT × spray; no chiller term
fitted_parameters: fan_fraction_of_it=0.025; evap aux 0.005 (priors, not reported facts)
modeling_assumptions: 2011 no-chiller design; fractions chosen to leave room for ~1.07 mild-weather PUE
calibration_target: none directly; annual PUE is a diagnostic vs 1.07
missing_information_limitation: No component meters. Constant COP is not used (and would be the wrong technology).

definition: P_fac = P_IT + P_fan + P_other + P_evap_aux. Hourly series is reconstructed; annual integral is forced to Meta electricity.
fitted_parameters: annual IT scale; facility overhead priors
modeling_assumptions: all auxiliaries counted once; hourly path is not a meter
independent_validation_source: unavailable hourly; annual value is the target itself
accuracy_diagnostic_available: closure residual ~0; do not call this predictive accuracy
confidence_level: high for annual reported E_fac; low for hourly P_fac
missing_information_limitation: No hourly feeder power.

definition: Meta-disclosed Prineville annual facility electricity. Hard observation for calibration.
raw_fields: site electricity tables in Meta PDFs (curated)
modeling_assumptions: disclosed site annual total is the campus facility electricity used by the model
calibration_target: this quantity IS the calibration target
missing_information_limitation: No monthly/hourly campus electricity observations.

definition: P_fac/P_IT from the gray-box. Annual modeled PUE ≈ 1.060. 2011 design full-load PUE 1.07 is a benchmark, not a fit target.
fitted_parameters: overhead priors; IT scale does not change PUE in the linear gray-box except via spray
modeling_assumptions: bottom-up PUE; not an independent input
independent_validation_source: 2011 design PUE 1.07; fleet PUE in Meta tables is not site annual telemetry
confidence_level: medium vs 2011 design; low as a claim of true hourly PUE
missing_information_limitation: No simultaneous IT and facility metering.

definition: Heat reuse is not modeled. Coarse balance Q_rej ≈ P_fac is not stored as an output.
equation_transformation_model: not implemented as a delivered quantity
missing_information_limitation: No recovered-heat meters; reuse not assumed.

definition: ISO/IEC 30134-9 WUE = consumption / IT energy. The pipeline does not observe site consumption. It reports withdrawal / facility electricity as a derived intensity and 2011 design WUE 0.31 L/kWh as a benchmark.
unit: L/kWh (facility withdrawal intensity); design WUE L/kWh_IT
implementation_status: partial: withdrawal/facility-kWh derived; ISO WUE unavailable
equation_transformation_model: intensity = 1000 × m³ / MWh_facility (withdrawal, not consumption; facility, not IT denominator)
modeling_assumptions: this is not ISO WUE
independent_validation_source: 2011 design WUE 0.31 L/kWh_IT is a different boundary
confidence_level: high for the derived withdrawal/facility ratio; ISO WUE unavailable
missing_information_limitation: No site consumption (needs discharge). Denominator is facility electricity, not IT energy.

definition: Gupta et al. generic cooling-tower WUE vs wet-bulb. Not implemented in executable code.
equation_transformation_model: glossary curves are not in src/prineville_graybox.py
missing_information_limitation: Code uses air-side evaporative humidification physics instead of a2 tower curves.

definition: Gray-box humidification water from humidity-ratio increase at constant moist-air enthalpy, converted m³/h.

calibration_target: none for the raw series; a later multiplicative scale maps it toward withdrawal
accuracy_diagnostic_available: used inside water-scale and evap_physics candidate models
confidence_level: low as a withdrawal estimate; medium as a weather-shaped evaporative index
missing_information_limitation: Not equal to withdrawal, consumption, blowdown, or municipal delivery.

definition: Cooling-tower mass-balance streams. Not implemented.

definition: Train-only global multiplicative scale on raw evaporation. Selected model is global (not one-break). Holdout years use the frozen train scale.
